definitions.explanation: A favorable time or situation for doing something.
A particular time when something happens.

examples.japanese: {機会|きかい}があれば{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: If I have the chance, I'd like to go.

examples.japanese: この{機会|きかい}に{感謝|かんしゃ}します。

notes:
{機会|きかい} means 'opportunity' or 'chance.'

Homophone: {機械|きかい} (machine) - same reading, different meaning!

Common collocations:
- {機会|きかい}がある: to have an opportunity
- {機会|きかい}を{逃|のが}す: to miss an opportunity
- {機会|きかい}を{利用|りよう}する: to take advantage of an opportunity
- この{機会|きかい}に: on this occasion

Similar words:
- チャンス: chance (casual)
- {好機|こうき}: favorable opportunity (formal)
